dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, and help are wired into the command; the no-selection path preserves the original table/exporter flow.

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical headers, and actionable unknown-field errors are present. Ambiguous IDs are collected in connection order without sorting, so deterministic candidate ordering is not ensured.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Selected fields reuse the initial ProjectItems field page and fetch additional pages only when indicated; failures return before rendering.
evidence: tests.log: focused Go test command passed

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value types are formatted; unmatched or unknown values are empty and CR/LF is normalized.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Resolved fields append ordered headers and each row looks up values by field ID, adding an empty cell when absent while retaining the established command path.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Flag, retrieval, and resolution failures return before table output. The focused diff uses existing query types and table rendering helpers.

criticalGaps: Ambiguous name diagnostics do not sort candidate field IDs, so their order is not guaranteed deterministic.
